config.create_echo_radars.title: Create: Echo Radars Settings
config.create_echo_radars.palette.descri: Color palette used by sonar monitors.
config.create_echo_radars.gain.descripti: Amplifies or reduces the displayed acoustic returns.
config.create_echo_radars.speckle.descri: Controls the strength of multiplicative display noise.
config.create_echo_radars.sonar_glass_mi: Hides the sonar grid on surfaces closer than this many blocks to the player.
config.create_echo_radars.sonar_glass_ac: Maximum distance in blocks from the player to connected sonar glass at which its active display is rendered.
config.create_echo_radars.sonar_glass_gr: Selects the procedural grid projected through active sonar glass.
config.create_echo_radars.point_gaps.des: Leaves a visible gap between adjacent sonar return cells.
config.create_echo_radars.block_sized_pi: Sizes each sonar pixel as one world block at its distance and keeps only the strongest of overlapping returns.
config.create_echo_radars.old_pixel_life: How long non-rotating sonar pixels remain visible while gradually losing brightness.
Old pixels: clear on new scan
Old pixels: replace at sweep front
config.create_echo_radars.mechanical_pix: Ticks until a pixel fully disappears. Auto mode uses rotation speed so brightness is 30% when the sweep line returns.
config.create_echo_radars.clear_old_pixe: Clear old pixels after full refresh
Immediately removes older frames when the newest reveal reaches 100%.
config.create_echo_radars.side_scan_data: Selects the edge where new frames appear. The waterfall has margins on every side and its distance and time scales follow the selected orientation.
config.create_echo_radars.debug.trace_ti: Logs aggregate worker and batch trace time every 10 seconds.
config.create_echo_radars.debug.ray_mode: Selects which rays the sonar debug tracer renders.
config.create_echo_radars.debug.note: Available only to operators. Logs are printed while the debug tracer is active.
config.create_echo_radars.operator.note: Server values are applied after the server confirms operator permissions.
config.create_echo_radars.presets.note: A preset updates the pending server values. Press Apply to save and send them to the server.
config.create_echo_radars.preset.perform: Lower base ray counts and four conditional additional rays for reduced server load.
config.create_echo_radars.preset.balance: Default compromise between sonar detail and tracing cost.
config.create_echo_radars.preset.quality: Higher base ray counts and sixteen additional rays for maximum detail.
config.create_echo_radars.server.horizon: Base horizontal ray count for this sonar. Odd values keep a centered beam.
config.create_echo_radars.server.vertica: Base vertical sub-ray count for this sonar.
config.create_echo_radars.server.additio: Number of extra rays distributed around every eligible primary hit.
config.create_echo_radars.server.refine_: Additional rays only for new nearby blocks
Skips additional rays when the same block or an adjacent block was already detected during this scan.
config.create_echo_radars.server.hit_ref: Blocks before a hit that local refinement rays scan again. Zero disables refinement.
config.create_echo_radars.server.blocks_: Maximum distance advanced by each sub-ray per server tick.
config.create_echo_radars.server.ping_pa: Server ticks to wait after one ping completes.
config.create_echo_radars.server.side_sc: Server ticks to wait after a side-scan pass. Lower values update the image more often.
Starts a new side-scan ping only after the sonar moves at least half a block. Disabled keeps it updating while stationary.
config.create_echo_radars.server.max_chu: Maximum simultaneous unloaded chunk NBT reads per level.
config.create_echo_radars.server.trace_w: Worker threads used for snapshot-only sonar ray tracing.
config.create_echo_radars.server.adaptiv: Reduces ray density only when average ticks exceed 80 ms and measured sonar work is a significant cause, then restores quality gradually after recovery. Normal server load does not change scan density or scheduling.
config.create_echo_radars.server.maximum: Maximum selectable range in blocks. Wide fields of view may reduce the effective maximum range.
config.create_echo_radars.server.angle_r: After the horizontal and vertical angle sum exceeds two thirds of this sonar's maximum angle sum, its maximum range decreases smoothly to one half at the widest angles.
config.create_echo_radars.server.entity_: Hides entity tracks when a solid block blocks the direct sonar ray.
